set.signal: Q2 2026 interim report: EBITDA was impacted by a SEK 42.9 m non-cash social security accounting expense related to the strong appreciation of the company's share price during the quarter. CEO Vickram Vathulya: the North Star remains delivering to the long-term financial model from 2028 onwards; the company is singularly focused on enabling the transformation into a product business in 2027.
